reuse.why: One shared ensureBankAccountNotLinked guard built on db.first serves every provider, and the link handlers are reused unchanged.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once, but the five registration wrappers repeat the same await-guard-then-delegate shape instead of using one wrapping helper.

placement.why: Domain validation is placed in inline lambdas in the app.method registration block, which this tree uses only for wiring, so the link functions themselves stay unguarded and the AccountHandlers types still point at the unwrapped functions.

scope.why: Only the guard, its wiring and focused tests.

maintainability.why: The guard is clean, but a reader of linkXAccount cannot see the rule, and a new provider has to remember to add another hand-written wrapper at registration.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five link methods are registered through the guarding wrappers.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated wrappers are visibly the same pattern, not disguised.

one_place.where: ensureBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, applied to all five *-accounts-link registrations.
